written.headline: Researchers propose meta‑access framework to extend LLM chat interfaces
written.summary: Julian Kunkel and Ali Doosthosseini submitted a paper describing meta access, a structured, permissioned view of a software interface that lets LLM chat agents read and modify UI state. The approach is demonstrated in a prototype called Meta Chat.

written.headline: VLA‑Tug probe improves early failure detection in vision‑language‑action models
written.summary: Researchers introduced VLA‑Tug, a lightweight latent probe that raises early failure detection by up to 30% and keeps missed‑detection and false‑alarm bounds valid in up to 86% of runs on unseen tasks.

written.headline: Three indicted for using AI to impersonate executives and lawyers in $129M fraud
written.summary: Three people were indicted in a U.S. District Court in New York on charges of wire fraud and aggravated identity theft for allegedly using AI to impersonate corporate executives and attorneys and steal about $129 million. The defendants, Jacob Soall, Sharon Hazan and Guy Sheetrit, targeted thousands of companies over more than a year and a half.

written.headline: Activists breach Microsoft data centre site in Amsterdam as protests spread across Europe
written.summary: More than 100 activists broke into the construction site of a Microsoft AI data centre in Amsterdam on Friday, the start of two days of protests in 15-16 European countries calling for a pause on large-scale data centre construction. The site, owned by Pure Data Centres with over $1 billion in planned investment, is proceeding despite Amsterdam's ban on new data centres until 2030.
